payload_selection: Exact explicit per-bundle source-report list in plan.json; no globbed cache payloads.
source_copy_policy: Preserve original bytes when no sanitization occurs; otherwise serialize parsed JSON in original key insertion order as UTF8, ensure_ascii=false,indent2, trailingLF. Do not alter protected historical value/text/raw/title/attribution or identity/hash/bounds/geometry fields.

tar.members: Files only, sorted by relative name; no directories or symbolic/hard links.

reproduction: Read all archive members, preserve bytes/names, repack with the exact tar/gzip specification above; same-runtime byte-identical output is required. Compression implementation changes can change compressed bytes.
authority: Current canonical catalog and active-withdrawal negative inventory determine eligibility. Archive contents are historical project apparatus.
additional_copy_sanitization_stage: After location/reference sanitization, replace transient harness reviewer task identities with neutral independent-source-reader metadata. Historical WORD values remain protected.
